deep_dive.executive_summary: Viatris is a post-merger generic pharma operator simplifying its portfolio, paying down debt, and returning cash while Idorsia Phase III assets (selatogrel, cenerimod) offer filing-backed upside. Normalized owner cash blends 50% Marvin floor ($1.45/sh from FY2025 operating cash flow) and 50% Rosen cash-yield normalization ($1.55/sh, approved Sohn 2026). At $15.69 we expect about 13.11% per year over seven years (total synthesis), including Rosen operating paths and a capped Idorsia catalyst lane; Marvin stress floor 9.9% on $1.45/sh. method_fit.rule: Use one primary method and no more than two corroborating methods; irrelevant methods and personas remain silent.
